segments.name: design, development and sale of integrated circuits
segments.description: Designs, develops and sells high-speed SRAM and APU compute-in-memory chips for networking, test and measurement, military/defense and edge AI customers.
segments.evidence: Based on its operating management and financial reporting structure, the Company has determined that it has one reportable business segment: the design, development and sale of integrated circuits.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for high-speed synchronous SRAM and APU integrated circuits and boards, with additional milestone payments from government development contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: We fund this development through our established legacy business designing and selling high-speed synchronous static random access memory ("SRAM") products, primarily for the networking and telecommunications, test and measurement, and military/defense and aerospace markets.
